prior_art.basis: Independent review by claude-independent-prior-art-reviewer-20261106: Text-to-floor-plan generators exist, but none produces buildable, permit-ready plans, so the Main KPI of 1,000,000,000 people able to generate buildable home plans is unmet. Independent guides say no AI floor plan generator yet produces drawings a building department accepts; outputs are schematic (https://www.maket.ai/blog/ai-floor-plan-generator-guide-2026). Maket and similar tools give basic code hints only (https://archgyan.com/maket-ai-floor-plan-generation-residential/); open research such as HouseDiffusion generates vector layouts without structure or code (https://github.com/aminshabani/house_diffusion). AI permit pre-checks such as Archistar with the ICC check plans against code for reviewers but do not author them (https://www.iccsafe.org/about/periodicals-and-newsroom/international-code-council-collaborates-with-archistar-to-modernize-permitting-and-accelerate-housing-development). Honest limit: schematic layout generation and rule-based code checking are known answers; new work is the gap between them (structure, services, jurisdiction-specific compliance and a licensed sign-off path), and vendor permit-ready claims were not independently verified.
